QV-EDL-V02-019-GOAL-CONTRADICTION-SCAN-A.finding: Strict bool semantics prevent truthiness coercion, but contradiction_clear is still caller-supplied and contradiction_scan_hash is only required to be non-empty. A caller can provide literal True plus any non-empty scan reference and satisfy GoalSurfacingEnvelope.verify without proving that a trusted, fresh contradiction scan actually cleared the goal.
QV-EDL-V02-019-GOAL-CONTRADICTION-SCAN-A.why_bounded: Goal surfacing remains proposal-only and cannot grant external action or drive/desire authority, so this is an owner-visible evidence-integrity risk rather than an execution-authority escalation.
required_repair: Replace free contradiction_clear + non-empty contradiction_scan_hash acceptance with a host-issued/registry-validated ContradictionScanReceipt or exact canonical scan reference.

Bind scan issuer/provider identity, exact goal canonical hash/semantic key, policy hash/version, protected owner/governance constraint snapshot, installation/workspace identity, freshness/revocation state and scan result.
Derive contradiction_clear from the validated scan record; do not accept it as an independent caller-controlled fact.
Fail closed on unknown issuer, stale/revoked scan, goal/hash mismatch, policy mismatch or cross-installation replay.
Keep owner-visible surfacing proposal-only with authority_from_drive=0 and external_action_allowed=false.

Before any formal slice, reference identifiers should use strict bounded scalar/hash contracts rather than arbitrary-object stringification.
